_note: What you see: Public page where an outsider fills in a requested secret.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Publieke pagina waar een buitenstaander een gevraagd geheim invult.
Iemand van Gemeente Zuiddrecht vraagt u: Someone from Municipality of Zuiddrecht asks you for the details below. You do not need an account for this.
Wat u invult wordt in uw browser versleu: What you fill in is encrypted in your browser before it is sent. Only the requester can read it.
After sending, the request is completed. Whoever opens the link afterwards sees it has already been filled in.
De server bewaart alleen versleutelde te: The server only stores encrypted text. Even the Keepiq administrator cannot see your value.
Neem contact op met de persoon die u de: Contact the person who sent you the link, through a channel you already know.
